comparison.objective: Seat and split a tablet in a V-cradle, versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-object seating and controlled blade closure/fracture versus recessed-tool alignment, collar tuning, counterholding, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Tablet correctly seated and divided versus two safe repeatable stops with no hard-stop strike or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Controlled cutting/fracture is unrelated to dynamic damper tuning. Body and specs are absent, so split quality and damage thresholds are missing.
